items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Bill Russell and I did. [referring to writing notes for an album sent to the interviewee]

ctx.x: Yeah, Jules Gallet, the clarinet player in that band, sent me a recording. The last album that they made. I've got it here. Yeah.
I wonder who wrote the notes for that album. Bill Russell and I did. Yeah.
Now, here's the band with, with, uh, with Johnny and, uh, Sterling Bowes. That's not. Oh, yeah.
